items.headline: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.excerpt: Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears. The threat is especially serious for AI agents with tool or terminal access. A

items.headline: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.excerpt: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code
